meta.name: arize-link
meta.description: Generate deep links to the Arize UI. Use when the user wants a clickable URL to open or share a specific trace, span, session, dataset, labeling queue, evaluator, or annotation config, or when sharing Arize resources with team members.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成可分享的Arize平台深度链接
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Arize中分享追踪、会话或数据集给同事。
copy.tagline_en: Generate shareable deep links to the Arize UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share traces, sessions, or datasets in Arize with teammates.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据你提供的资源 ID（如 trace、span、数据集等）生成一个可直接点击的链接，带你跳转到 Arize 平台的对应页面。
howto.when: 当你想要打开或分享某个 trace、span、session、数据集等 Arize 资源，或者需要根据导出数据中的 ID 创建链接时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成这个 trace 的链接。
把最近导出的数据集链接给我。
say.note: 需提供 dataset_id 等必要信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates clickable deep links to the Arize UI for resources like traces, spans, sessions, datasets, labeling queues, evaluators, or annotation configs based on provided IDs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to open or share a specific Arize resource, or when you have IDs from exported data and need to link back to the UI.

say_en.text: Generate a link for this trace.
say_en.note: Claude will need base64-encoded IDs like org_id, space_id, etc.

say_en.text: Provide a link to the dataset I just exported.
say_en.note: You need to supply the dataset_id and other required IDs.
